title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Peach Mango Watermelon Prefilled Vape Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Peach Mango Watermelon brings together three sunny fruits in one irresistibly juicy, tropical blend. Rich, sweet Peach forms the base, joined by sun-ripened Mango for depth and a lush, light tang. Fresh Watermelon lifts the profile with a gentle, refreshing sweetness, creating a perfectly balanced combination of fruit flavours in every puff. Each pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, made exclusively for the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. Together, they offer up to 6000 puffs (based on personal usage) of vibrant flavour and smooth vapour. With dual mesh coil technology, the pod delivers clear, consistent flavour and dense vapour. The automatic refill system and leak-resistant design ensure an easy, low-maintenance experience. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod delivers quick nicotine satisfaction and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, tailored for MTL vaping. When empty, simply swap out the pod and refill container for uninterrupted enjoyment.
